data.one_liner: Pure‑Flutter map client with tile loading, markers, and gestures
data.what_it_does: Provides a fully cross‑platform map widget that renders map tiles, supports markers, popups, and user gestures like pan, zoom, and double‑tap. It is vendor‑free and works on Android, iOS, web, and desktop.
use_when: You need an open‑source map solution without external SDKs
You want full control over map rendering and styling
You target multiple platforms including web and desktop
avoid_when: You require native map SDK features such as offline maps or advanced geofencing
You need a lightweight solution with minimal dependencies
strengths: Active maintenance with recent bug fixes
Extensible via plugins for custom layers and controls
weaknesses: No native offline map caching out of the box
Requires manual handling of permissions for location services
Large dependency set may increase bundle size
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_map to pubspec, import package, no special permissions required unless using location services

alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides location services but not map rendering
